original_test_intent: Perform the source-defined in-band IPMI Master Write-Read transaction only against an owner-approved I2C target/register and verify exact response.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Resolve bus/channel/address/register semantics, prove the one-byte write is safe, execute once and decode response.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Transaction completes and returned data matches the target contract.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED BLOCKED to REQUIRES because standard request is automatable, but unidentified write is unsafe.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Hardware/BMC owner provides and approves exact endpoint/register semantics.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Finite Master Write-Read transaction including original byte payload.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Bus/MUX/device/register map, safe-write meaning and expected response.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Tool success without endpoint semantics is not functional coverage.

original_method: Standard IPMI Master Write-Read retained; live write prohibited until mapped.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve stable topology and run one reviewed byte-level request with pre/post device health.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: IPMI command definition plus target device/platform register documentation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only the approved endpoint/transaction is covered.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Writing 0x00 to an unknown device can alter critical state.

safety_boundaries: No guessed MUX or force access
no_automatic_retry: Any NACK/unexpected response stops; no alternate address.
review_improvement: KEEP: missing device contract remains a safety gate but not a permanent automation class block.
